Senior Data Engineer

Join our data platform team building pipelines for an insurance client.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain Databricks pipelines over Delta Lake
- Tune PySpark jobs for cost and throughput
- Design ingestion with Azure Data Factory
- Automate orchestration in Airflow

Requirements:
- 5+ years of strong Databricks experience, must have
- Strong PySpark required
- Azure Data Factory experience required
- Advanced SQL for modelling and tuning
- Kafka exposure is nice to have
- 5 to 8 years of total experience
